narrative.overview: You are at the edge of the court and the match is the thing. The interface takes the seat, not the court: a premium, understated surface makes a phone-shot rally look worth watching, where a loud one would compete with it and lose. The material is warm paper rather than glass or neon - cream grounds, soft tan borders, a muted club green at lower chroma than most apps' neutrals. Surfaces are flat and separated by a hairline border. Type is the platform's own; no font ships with the app. The palette is not one world but six, and every screen is authored once and recoloured at draw time, which is why every palette must define every slot.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper neutrals, never grey and never white
Low-chroma accents; club signage, not sports-brand green
Flat by default - hairline borders separate, shadows only lift
Platform type only; no brand font, no icon font, no shipped imagery
Six complete palettes, one authored source

rules.name: The Warm Neutral Rule
rules.body: No pure white and no pure black anywhere. Every neutral carries warmth.

rules.name: The Every-Slot Rule
rules.body: Every palette defines every colour key, and no component writes a literal hex. Breakage is silent: correct in the default theme, wrong in a slam theme.

rules.name: The Surface Vocabulary Rule
rules.body: Clay, hard, grass and court classify; they never command. A surface colour on a button is a category error.

rules.name: The Tight Top Rule
rules.body: Tracking tightens as size grows and opens only at label size.

rules.name: The Two-Weight Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from weight and size; colour reinforces but never carries it alone.

rules.name: The One Column Rule
rules.body: Content never spans a large screen. Past the cap the space stays empty or becomes the rail.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: On the page: a border. Over the page: a shadow. Never both.

rules.name: The Pill Rule
rules.body: Actions are pills; containers are rounded rectangles. If it is fully round, you can press it.

dos: Do take every colour from the theme, so all six palettes keep working.
Do separate surfaces with a 1px border and a half-step of warmth.
Do keep actions pill-shaped and containers rounded-rectangular.
Do let type weight carry hierarchy, with colour as reinforcement.
Do give a clip the whole viewport.
Do outline destructive actions rather than filling them.
donts: Don't write a literal hex in a component.
Don't use #FFFFFF or #000000. Every neutral is warm.
Don't add a shadow to something that sits on the page.
Don't use a surface colour (clay, hard, grass, court) as an action colour.
Don't introduce a webfont or an icon font.
Don't ship placeholder imagery. Initials and court cards are the placeholder system.
